posteriores.texto: Quem confia em suas riquezas cairá, mas os justos florescerão como a folhagem.
Quem perturba a própria casa herdará vento, e o tolo será escravo do sábio de coração.

kjv.texto: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

vizinhos.26: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
vizinhos.28: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
